findings: DEC-122 FINDING (l.532–535): « V est ainsi munie d'une structure d'espace fibré ℝ⁺-principal : cet espace fibré est topologiquement trivial » is false, in every Benzécri dimension n ≥ 3 (DEC-124), without a hypothesis the paper does not print. W = {v : v₂ > 0, (v₀,v₁) ≠ 0} ⊂ ℝⁿ∖0 modulo A = diag(4, 1/8, 2, 1, …, 1) is a Hausdorff, second countable, connected, paracompact affine conical n-manifold whose base B = V/ℝ⁺ is not Hausdorff ([(1,0,…)] and [(0,1,…)] inseparable), so V is homeomorphic to B × ℝ₊* by no homeomorphism (Benzecri.ConeCex.isEmpty_homeomorph_dim, Benzecri.ConeCex.not_def3TrivialAsPrinted_dim; n = 3: Benzecri.ConeCex.isEmpty_homeomorph, Benzecri.ConeCex.not_def3TrivialAsPrinted; Cone/Counterexample). The corrected statement adds that ℝ₊* acts properly, equivalently B Hausdorff (ConeBase.t2Space_iff_properSMul); it holds with no extra hypothesis for n ≤ 2 (Cone/LowDim).
